# upstream/

Code imported from the [Kotlin compiler](https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin) (Apache 2.0, see
`../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE-kotlin.txt`): the hand-written Java parser (`parser/`) and the token
definitions (`lexer/`). It is compiled together with `src/main`, in its own package `me.kevinlot.lite.kotlin.upstream` (our code never lives there).

**Do not edit by hand.** These files are regenerated by `tools/import_kotlin_parser.py`, which copies
them from the compiler sources and applies the Lite adaptations (packages, plain node types instead of
stubs, KDoc as a single token, eager parsing). Changes belong in that script or in `src/main/kotlin`.

The lexer comes from `src/main/grammars/Kotlin.flex` (also imported) and is generated at build time.
